meta.title: Unbreakable Protection
meta.description: This shield will endure all manner of sky-scorching thunderbolts and lethal strikes.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector, in the depths of the Outer Ring.
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector, in the depths of the Outer Ring.

spans.text: Tartarus Sector, in the depths of the Outer Ring.

units.rawText: Having withdrawn to the depths of the labyrinth, we now follow the Rubik's Map and swap routes over and over again, turning corner after corner in rapid succession.
units.displayText: Having withdrawn to the depths of the labyrinth, we now follow the Rubik's Map and swap routes over and over again, turning corner after corner in rapid succession.

spans.text: Having withdrawn to the depths of the labyrinth, we now follow the Rubik's Map and swap routes over and over again, turning corner after corner in rapid succession.

units.rawText: The walls on both sides of us are covered in purple growths that look like some kind of vegetation and stretch as far as the eye can see, the unidentifiable alien substance rippling slowly like waves on the sea. Cold light shines through the depths of the material, their rustling sounds like the chirping of chicks.

units.rawText: Watch your side—
units.displayText: Watch your side—

spans.text: Watch your side—

units.rawText: Shing—Clang—
units.displayText: Shing—Clang—

spans.text: Shing—Clang—

units.rawText: The greatsword rises and cuts apart the dark purple tentacle just as I call it out. Severed from its root, the soft appendage falls to the ground and thrashes wildly, as though rebuking us for our rudeness as visitors.
units.displayText: The greatsword rises and cuts apart the dark purple tentacle just as I call it out. Severed from its root, the soft appendage falls to the ground and thrashes wildly, as though rebuking us for our rudeness as visitors.

units.rawText: Relax, I've handled things like these all the time. Just plan our route and leave the enemies to me, buddy.
units.displayText: Relax, I've handled things like these all the time. Just plan our route and leave the enemies to me, buddy.

spans.text: Relax, I've handled things like these all the time. Just plan our route and leave the enemies to me, buddy.

units.rawText: You too, Alcyone. Don't push yourself too hard. Are you and Electra okay?
units.displayText: You too, Alcyone. Don't push yourself too hard. Are you and Electra okay?

spans.text: You too, Alcyone. Don't push yourself too hard. Are you and Electra okay?

units.rawText: Electra's entered sleep mode and her condition is stable. I... (inhales) I...
units.displayText: Electra's entered sleep mode and her condition is stable. I... (inhales) I...

spans.text: Electra's entered sleep mode and her condition is stable. I... (inhales) I...

units.rawText: The golden arrow that Alcyone fires is her response to us.
units.displayText: The golden arrow that Alcyone fires is her response to us.

spans.text: The golden arrow that Alcyone fires is her response to us.

units.rawText: —I can still fight.
units.displayText: —I can still fight.

spans.text: —I can still fight.

units.rawText: You need to know your limits. If you can't do it, let me take over... (coughs)
units.displayText: You need to know your limits. If you can't do it, let me take over... (coughs)

spans.text: You need to know your limits. If you can't do it, let me take over... (coughs)

units.rawText: Atlas? That wound on your waist...
units.displayText: Atlas? That wound on your waist...

spans.text: Atlas? That wound on your waist...

units.rawText: Well... Haha, guess that explosion was more powerful than I expected. The barrier I put up beforehand couldn't stop its full force.
units.displayText: Well... Haha, guess that explosion was more powerful than I expected. The barrier I put up beforehand couldn't stop its full force.

spans.text: Well... Haha, guess that explosion was more powerful than I expected. The barrier I put up beforehand couldn't stop its full force.

units.rawText: Man, I feel so dumb for making such a basic mistake. Anyway, it's no big deal. I'll just heal up once we get to the Middle Ring. There are more important things to do now.
units.displayText: Man, I feel so dumb for making such a basic mistake. Anyway, it's no big deal. I'll just heal up once we get to the Middle Ring. There are more important things to do now.

spans.text: Man, I feel so dumb for making such a basic mistake. Anyway, it's no big deal. I'll just heal up once we get to the Middle Ring. There are more important things to do now.

units.rawText: The smile fades off Atlas' face as he surveys his surroundings warily without slowing his pace.
units.displayText: The smile fades off Atlas' face as he surveys his surroundings warily without slowing his pace.

spans.text: The smile fades off Atlas' face as he surveys his surroundings warily without slowing his pace.

units.rawText: At first, I wanted to use the explosion to kill that Entropic called Caina, but it didn't work.
units.displayText: At first, I wanted to use the explosion to kill that Entropic called Caina, but it didn't work.

spans.text: At first, I wanted to use the explosion to kill that Entropic called Caina, but it didn't work.

units.rawText: I can't believe she could still fight after being blown up like that...
units.displayText: I can't believe she could still fight after being blown up like that...

spans.text: I can't believe she could still fight after being blown up like that...

units.rawText: She's much stronger than the other High-Order Entropics we've fought before. I have a bad feeling about this... Feels like she might catch up with us soon.
units.displayText: She's much stronger than the other High-Order Entropics we've fought before. I have a bad feeling about this... Feels like she might catch up with us soon.

spans.text: She's much stronger than the other High-Order Entropics we've fought before. I have a bad feeling about this... Feels like she might catch up with us soon.

units.rawText: Looks like it isn't time for us to enter the Middle Ring yet. Let me handle the route and battle planning; we need to break through the Entropic encirclement first.
units.displayText: Looks like it isn't time for us to enter the Middle Ring yet. Let me handle the route and battle planning; we need to break through the Entropic encirclement first.

spans.text: Looks like it isn't time for us to enter the Middle Ring yet. Let me handle the route and battle planning; we need to break through the Entropic encirclement first.

units.rawText: I'll clear the path, you guys stay close. Don't get left behind!
units.displayText: I'll clear the path, you guys stay close. Don't get left behind!

spans.text: I'll clear the path, you guys stay close. Don't get left behind!

units.rawText: It should be safe here, we can rest for a bit.
units.displayText: It should be safe here, we can rest for a bit.

spans.text: It should be safe here, we can rest for a bit.

units.rawText: Yeah, you do that. I'll stand watch.
units.displayText: Yeah, you do that. I'll stand watch.

spans.text: Yeah, you do that. I'll stand watch.

units.rawText: Atlas doesn't sit down. Instead, he looks toward the main energy tower with a grim expression on his face.
units.displayText: Atlas doesn't sit down. Instead, he looks toward the main energy tower with a grim expression on his face.

spans.text: Atlas doesn't sit down. Instead, he looks toward the main energy tower with a grim expression on his face.

units.rawText: We need to think of a way to deal with Caina. If she keeps hounding us, we'll only be in more danger once we enter the Middle Ring. It might even end up compromising our later objectives.
units.displayText: We need to think of a way to deal with Caina. If she keeps hounding us, we'll only be in more danger once we enter the Middle Ring. It might even end up compromising our later objectives.

spans.text: We need to think of a way to deal with Caina. If she keeps hounding us, we'll only be in more danger once we enter the Middle Ring. It might even end up compromising our later objectives.

units.rawText: ...She was dogging us constantly earlier. Maybe the labyrinth has some kind of mechanism to it that we don't know about...
units.displayText: ...She was dogging us constantly earlier. Maybe the labyrinth has some kind of mechanism to it that we don't know about...

spans.text: ...She was dogging us constantly earlier. Maybe the labyrinth has some kind of mechanism to it that we don't know about...

units.rawText: Alcyone carefully lays Electra down. After looking at her eyes, she clenches her fists.
units.displayText: Alcyone carefully lays Electra down. After looking at her eyes, she clenches her fists.

spans.text: Alcyone carefully lays Electra down. After looking at her eyes, she clenches her fists.

units.rawText: Caina... I'll make her pay for this!
units.displayText: Caina... I'll make her pay for this!

spans.text: Caina... I'll make her pay for this!
Calm down, stay cautious.

options.rawText: Leave it to me. This time, we'll crush her for good!
options.displayText: Leave it to me. This time, we'll crush her for good!

spans.text: Leave it to me. This time, we'll crush her for good!

units.rawText: The Entropics we've encountered in Tartarus are far stronger than before, especially after that wave from just now...
units.displayText: The Entropics we've encountered in Tartarus are far stronger than before, especially after that wave from just now...

spans.text: The Entropics we've encountered in Tartarus are far stronger than before, especially after that wave from just now...

units.rawText: (Inhales) You're right, <cmdr>. I endangered Electra because I was too impulsive. I can't repeat my past mistakes...
units.displayText: (Inhales) You're right, {교수}. I endangered Electra because I was too impulsive. I can't repeat my past mistakes...

spans.text: (Inhales) You're right,
. I endangered Electra because I was too impulsive. I can't repeat my past mistakes...

units.rawText: It'll be alright, Alcyone. My buddy and I are on the job. Now that we've got three Greater Sanctifiers fighting at full power, she won't be able to beat us even if she IS stronger than other High-Order Entropics.
units.displayText: It'll be alright, Alcyone. My buddy and I are on the job. Now that we've got three Greater Sanctifiers fighting at full power, she won't be able to beat us even if she IS stronger than other High-Order Entropics.

spans.text: It'll be alright, Alcyone. My buddy and I are on the job. Now that we've got three Greater Sanctifiers fighting at full power, she won't be able to beat us even if she IS stronger than other High-Order Entropics.

units.rawText: Hahahaha, that's the spirit, buddy!
units.displayText: Hahahaha, that's the spirit, buddy!

spans.text: Hahahaha, that's the spirit, buddy!

units.rawText: Atlas puts his arms around me and Alcyone.
units.displayText: Atlas puts his arms around me and Alcyone.

spans.text: Atlas puts his arms around me and Alcyone.

units.rawText: Now that we've got three Greater Sanctifiers fighting at full power, she won't be able to beat us even if she IS stronger than other High-Order Entropics.

units.rawText: And besides, since we know she'll chase us, we have the initiative.
units.displayText: And besides, since we know she'll chase us, we have the initiative.

spans.text: And besides, since we know she'll chase us, we have the initiative.

units.rawText: Atlas points to the Rubik's Map I'm holding and we exchange a wordless glance.
units.displayText: Atlas points to the Rubik's Map I'm holding and we exchange a wordless glance.

spans.text: Atlas points to the Rubik's Map I'm holding and we exchange a wordless glance.

units.rawText: This time, we're going to plan beforehand and completely crush her!
units.displayText: This time, we're going to plan beforehand and completely crush her!

spans.text: This time, we're going to plan beforehand and completely crush her!

units.rawText: Give me some time. We need to take the failure of the Spoof Code and the strength of the Entropics into consideration. After all, they're a far cry from the Entropics we first encountered when we just entered the Outer Ring.
units.displayText: Give me some time. We need to take the failure of the Spoof Code and the strength of the Entropics into consideration. After all, they're a far cry from the Entropics we first encountered when we just entered the Outer Ring.

spans.text: Give me some time. We need to take the failure of the Spoof Code and the strength of the Entropics into consideration. After all, they're a far cry from the Entropics we first encountered when we just entered the Outer Ring.

units.rawText: The data doesn't lie; I kept an eye on our operand expenditures just now, and we're using almost twice the usual normal of operands to kill Low-Order Entropics.
units.displayText: The data doesn't lie; I kept an eye on our operand expenditures just now, and we're using almost twice the usual normal of operands to kill Low-Order Entropics.

spans.text: The data doesn't lie; I kept an eye on our operand expenditures just now, and we're using almost twice the usual normal of operands to kill Low-Order Entropics.

units.rawText: Then you factor in the intel from the frontline units and the real-time route information from the Rubik's Map...
units.displayText: Then you factor in the intel from the frontline units and the real-time route information from the Rubik's Map...

spans.text: Then you factor in the intel from the frontline units and the real-time route information from the Rubik's Map...

units.rawText: The Rubik's Map I'm holding works at high speed, feeding me visual data.
units.displayText: The Rubik's Map I'm holding works at high speed, feeding me visual data.

spans.text: The Rubik's Map I'm holding works at high speed, feeding me visual data.

units.rawText: This is it. There's a place not far ahead that's good for setting an ambush.
units.displayText: This is it. There's a place not far ahead that's good for setting an ambush.

spans.text: This is it. There's a place not far ahead that's good for setting an ambush.

units.rawText: I indicate a region on my display and rapidly concoct a plan.
units.displayText: I indicate a region on my display and rapidly concoct a plan.

spans.text: I indicate a region on my display and rapidly concoct a plan.

units.rawText: Currently, there are two ambush plans, both of which have roughly the same chances of success. The difference is in the risk to us. Plan 1 shares the risk evenly, while plan 2 puts more risk on Atlas, but keeps Alcyone and Electra safer.
units.displayText: Currently, there are two ambush plans, both of which have roughly the same chances of success. The difference is in the risk to us. Plan 1 shares the risk evenly, while plan 2 puts more risk on Atlas, but keeps Alcyone and Electra safer.

spans.text: Currently, there are two ambush plans, both of which have roughly the same chances of success. The difference is in the risk to us. Plan 1 shares the risk evenly, while plan 2 puts more risk on Atlas, but keeps Alcyone and Electra safer.

units.rawText: Plan 2 it is.
units.displayText: Plan 2 it is.

spans.text: Plan 2 it is.

units.rawText: ...But!
units.displayText: ...But!

spans.text: ...But!

units.rawText: I'm guessing that in plan 2 I can't protect Electra.
units.displayText: I'm guessing that in plan 2 I can't protect Electra.

spans.text: I'm guessing that in plan 2 I can't protect Electra.

units.rawText: Atlas pats Alcyone's head.
units.displayText: Atlas pats Alcyone's head.

spans.text: Atlas pats Alcyone's head.

units.rawText: That's why I need you to do it, Alcyone.
units.displayText: That's why I need you to do it, Alcyone.

spans.text: That's why I need you to do it, Alcyone.

units.rawText: ...Got it.
units.displayText: ...Got it.

spans.text: ...Got it.

units.rawText: After we finish our planning, we soon arrive at the designated area. Atlas and I scout the path ahead while Alcyone stays behind to check the plan and Electra's condition while occasionally feeding us info.
units.displayText: After we finish our planning, we soon arrive at the designated area. Atlas and I scout the path ahead while Alcyone stays behind to check the plan and Electra's condition while occasionally feeding us info.

spans.text: After we finish our planning, we soon arrive at the designated area. Atlas and I scout the path ahead while Alcyone stays behind to check the plan and Electra's condition while occasionally feeding us info.

units.rawText: Electra's body temperature is very high. Her neural cloud systems are restarting; she should be able to wake up soon!
units.displayText: Electra's body temperature is very high. Her neural cloud systems are restarting; she should be able to wake up soon!

spans.text: Electra's body temperature is very high. Her neural cloud systems are restarting; she should be able to wake up soon!

units.rawText: Hahaha, looks like we'll have two pieces of good news soon.
units.displayText: Hahaha, looks like we'll have two pieces of good news soon.

spans.text: Hahaha, looks like we'll have two pieces of good news soon.

units.rawText: Alcyone...
units.displayText: Alcyone...

spans.text: Alcyone...

units.rawText: I'm about to tell Alcyone to cool it, but Atlas pulls me aside and shakes his head.
units.displayText: I'm about to tell Alcyone to cool it, but Atlas pulls me aside and shakes his head.

spans.text: I'm about to tell Alcyone to cool it, but Atlas pulls me aside and shakes his head.

units.rawText: It's okay. Leave Alcyone be. This is her way of calming down.
units.displayText: It's okay. Leave Alcyone be. This is her way of calming down.

spans.text: It's okay. Leave Alcyone be. This is her way of calming down.

units.rawText: We haven't picked up Caina approaching yet, so there's nothing for Alcyone to do now. She must be beating herself up about how Electra got hurt.
units.displayText: We haven't picked up Caina approaching yet, so there's nothing for Alcyone to do now. She must be beating herself up about how Electra got hurt.

spans.text: We haven't picked up Caina approaching yet, so there's nothing for Alcyone to do now. She must be beating herself up about how Electra got hurt.

units.rawText: ...You really know her well.
units.displayText: ...You really know her well.

spans.text: ...You really know her well.

units.rawText: You know her well, too. Well, them. You've just forgotten.
units.displayText: You know her well, too. Well, them. You've just forgotten.

spans.text: You know her well, too. Well, them. You've just forgotten.

units.rawText: Atlas pats my back.
units.displayText: Atlas pats my back.

spans.text: Atlas pats my back.

units.rawText: Let's continue clearing the path, buddy. It's here, right?
units.displayText: Let's continue clearing the path, buddy. It's here, right?

spans.text: Let's continue clearing the path, buddy. It's here, right?

units.rawText: That's right. The fork here will bait Caina towards our ambush point. However, we need to clear away the Entropics near the passageway.
units.displayText: That's right. The fork here will bait Caina towards our ambush point. However, we need to clear away the Entropics near the passageway.

spans.text: That's right. The fork here will bait Caina towards our ambush point. However, we need to clear away the Entropics near the passageway.

units.rawText: Roger that!
units.displayText: Roger that!

spans.text: Roger that!

units.rawText: Atlas takes up Alcyone's bow with practiced movements and, after a brief adjustment, takes aim at the walls.
units.displayText: Atlas takes up Alcyone's bow with practiced movements and, after a brief adjustment, takes aim at the walls.

spans.text: Atlas takes up Alcyone's bow with practiced movements and, after a brief adjustment, takes aim at the walls.

units.rawText: There is a whoosh as arrows streak through the air, and by the time the sound fades, the slimy Entropics on the wall have stopped moving.
units.displayText: There is a whoosh as arrows streak through the air, and by the time the sound fades, the slimy Entropics on the wall have stopped moving.

spans.text: There is a whoosh as arrows streak through the air, and by the time the sound fades, the slimy Entropics on the wall have stopped moving.

units.rawText: The traps on the ground are cleared. I also have a few "surprises" for Caina besides that.
units.displayText: The traps on the ground are cleared. I also have a few "surprises" for Caina besides that.

spans.text: The traps on the ground are cleared. I also have a few "surprises" for Caina besides that.

units.rawText: Explosive ones?
units.displayText: Explosive ones?

spans.text: Explosive ones?

units.rawText: Hahaha, you got it, buddy. Alcyone has explosive arrows in her quiver, which can be command-detonated through a coded order. Combine that with the remaining operands left on the wall and it should be even more damaging.
units.displayText: Hahaha, you got it, buddy. Alcyone has explosive arrows in her quiver, which can be command-detonated through a coded order. Combine that with the remaining operands left on the wall and it should be even more damaging.

spans.text: Hahaha, you got it, buddy. Alcyone has explosive arrows in her quiver, which can be command-detonated through a coded order. Combine that with the remaining operands left on the wall and it should be even more damaging.

units.rawText: We'll have to leave the detonation timing to Alcyone, then.
units.displayText: We'll have to leave the detonation timing to Alcyone, then.

spans.text: We'll have to leave the detonation timing to Alcyone, then.

units.rawText: Saying so, Atlas hands the bow and the detonation codes to Alcyone.
units.displayText: Saying so, Atlas hands the bow and the detonation codes to Alcyone.

spans.text: Saying so, Atlas hands the bow and the detonation codes to Alcyone.

units.rawText: ...I see. Good idea.
units.displayText: ...I see. Good idea.

spans.text: ...I see. Good idea.

units.rawText: You inspired me to do it, buddy.
units.displayText: You inspired me to do it, buddy.

spans.text: You inspired me to do it, buddy.

units.rawText: Atlas pats my shoulder and after glancing back at Alcyone's who's fussing over Electra's condition, he heads over to the designated location and takes a fighting stance.
units.displayText: Atlas pats my shoulder and after glancing back at Alcyone's who's fussing over Electra's condition, he heads over to the designated location and takes a fighting stance.

spans.text: Atlas pats my shoulder and after glancing back at Alcyone's who's fussing over Electra's condition, he heads over to the designated location and takes a fighting stance.

units.rawText: Well, preparations are complete. All that's left is for Caina to show up.
units.displayText: Well, preparations are complete. All that's left is for Caina to show up.

spans.text: Well, preparations are complete. All that's left is for Caina to show up.

units.rawText: ...Was I this familiar with their weapons before?
units.displayText: ...Was I this familiar with their weapons before?

spans.text: ...Was I this familiar with their weapons before?

units.rawText: Hahaha, are you talking about using Alcyone's bow to leave Caina a "surprise"?
units.displayText: Hahaha, are you talking about using Alcyone's bow to leave Caina a "surprise"?

spans.text: Hahaha, are you talking about using Alcyone's bow to leave Caina a "surprise"?

units.rawText: Atlas strokes his chin, as though he's recalling distant memories.
units.displayText: Atlas strokes his chin, as though he's recalling distant memories.

spans.text: Atlas strokes his chin, as though he's recalling distant memories.

units.rawText: When I first started training Alcyone, she picked things up quickly, but she always forgot to manage her supply of consumables and maintain her weapon.
units.displayText: When I first started training Alcyone, she picked things up quickly, but she always forgot to manage her supply of consumables and maintain her weapon.

spans.text: When I first started training Alcyone, she picked things up quickly, but she always forgot to manage her supply of consumables and maintain her weapon.

units.rawText: So it was often the case where she'd shoot and shoot and suddenly find her quiver empty. Of course, this still happens every now and then.
units.displayText: So it was often the case where she'd shoot and shoot and suddenly find her quiver empty. Of course, this still happens every now and then.

spans.text: So it was often the case where she'd shoot and shoot and suddenly find her quiver empty. Of course, this still happens every now and then.

units.rawText: So you were in charge of Alcyone's gear and maintaining it in the past?
units.displayText: So you were in charge of Alcyone's gear and maintaining it in the past?

spans.text: So you were in charge of Alcyone's gear and maintaining it in the past?

units.rawText: I also did some coaching. I wasn't really "in charge" of it, I just helped check on her when I got a little worried.
units.displayText: I also did some coaching. I wasn't really "in charge" of it, I just helped check on her when I got a little worried.

spans.text: I also did some coaching. I wasn't really "in charge" of it, I just helped check on her when I got a little worried.

units.rawText: What a surprise.
units.displayText: What a surprise.

spans.text: What a surprise.

units.rawText: Really? You did the same thing, though.
units.displayText: Really? You did the same thing, though.

spans.text: Really? You did the same thing, though.

units.rawText: Me?
units.displayText: Me?

spans.text: Me?

units.rawText: You were really good with short swords, and even better with weapon schematics. If you don't believe me, you can check your database and see.
units.displayText: You were really good with short swords, and even better with weapon schematics. If you don't believe me, you can check your database and see.

spans.text: You were really good with short swords, and even better with weapon schematics. If you don't believe me, you can check your database and see.

units.rawText: ...Does that mean I was the one who mentored Electra...
units.displayText: ...Does that mean I was the one who mentored Electra...

spans.text: ...Does that mean I was the one who mentored Electra...

units.rawText: Hahaha, yup. We decided by rolling on it.
units.displayText: Hahaha, yup. We decided by rolling on it.

spans.text: Hahaha, yup. We decided by rolling on it.

units.rawText: Although I don't have these memories, I can't help but smile in response to Atlas' narration.
units.displayText: Although I don't have these memories, I can't help but smile in response to Atlas' narration.

spans.text: Although I don't have these memories, I can't help but smile in response to Atlas' narration.

units.rawText: After our idle chatter, Alcyone doesn't seem as anxious as before. She's fully ready for battle.
units.displayText: After our idle chatter, Alcyone doesn't seem as anxious as before. She's fully ready for battle.

spans.text: After our idle chatter, Alcyone doesn't seem as anxious as before. She's fully ready for battle.

units.rawText: Just then, a wave of bright red alerts fill our vision before slowly fading away.
units.displayText: Just then, a wave of bright red alerts fill our vision before slowly fading away.

spans.text: Just then, a wave of bright red alerts fill our vision before slowly fading away.

units.rawText: Careful, she's coming!
units.displayText: Careful, she's coming!
